lines.text: I just loaded this gift card. It's empty!
Somebody spent it. Before you even bought it.
Cool. A time-traveling thief.
Thieves grab cards right off the store rack.
They scratch or peel the back and copy the number and PIN.
Then they cover it up and hang it back.
So it just sits there? Like a trap?
A trap with a bow on it.
You pay at the register. The card goes live.
They wait. Once money lands, they spend it online.
They don't even need the card?
Nope. Some even swap the barcode, so your money loads their card.
So I bought a gift card. For a criminal.
Very generous. He says thanks.
So how do I not get robbed?
Check the back. Stickers on, PIN covered, nothing scratched.
Looks messed with? Grab another one and tell the cashier.
Keep the receipt and a photo of the card.
And anyone asking you to pay in gift cards? Scam.
Trust no rack.
Sure. And now you know.
Anyway. So yesterday...
